cs.t: I'm going to be graduating from a twenty year affair with Microsoft Natural Ergonomic 4000s to a Keyboardio Model 100. I'm bookmarking all these interesting ideas for then! Currently I just have capslock remapped to ctrl, which is awesome. However I also have a FS3-P USB Triple Foot Switch which is surprisingly handy. Cannot map a pedal as CTRL, as it is a separate keyboard device, but esc for Vim use, and ctrl-w have been useful common keys for me to be able to stomp on.  https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/keyboardio/model-100   https://duckduckgo.com/?kp=-1&kl=au-en&q=FS3-P+USB+Triple+Fo...
cs.th: Tell HN: Have just discovered that I can use any key as Ctrl on my keyboard\
